Preparation of Standard Solution of Mohr's Salt (Ferrous ammonium sulphate).
We require 250ml conical flask, 250ml standard flask, Mohr’s salt crystals, 250ml beaker, distilled water, funnel, weighing bottle, electronic balance, dil.H[sub]2[/sub]SO[sub]4[/sub],
20ml pipette, test tube, measuring jar, spatula, glass rod, white tile, tripod stand, wire gauze, Bunsen burner etc.
Take a weighing bottle and place it on an electronic balance.

Tare the balance.
Using a spatula take Mohr’s salt.
Put it in the weighing bottle.
Weigh about 4.9g of Mohr’s salt crystals.
Remove the weighing bottle from the balance.
Carefully transfer the weighed quantity of Mohr’s salt into a 250ml beaker.

Pour the washings into the beaker.
Dissolve Mohr’s salt crystals in the beaker by gentle stirring with a clean glass rod.
Then transfer the entire solution from the beaker into a 250ml standard flask using a funnel.
Wash the beaker with distilled water to transfer the solution sticking to it into the standard flask.(Repeat this 2 or 3 times).
Transfer the washings into the standard flask.

Add the last few drops of distilled water from the pipette until the lower level of the meniscus just touches the mark on the standard flask.
